name: Trinity Airways livery
description: The Trinity Airways identity after Sono Group's takeover of t'way: a gray and rose-gold scheme with a wide-set 'TRINITY' wordmark and a three-part rose-gold symbol. Described only; not yet drawn (no openly licensed photo).

sources.title: Korea's T'way Air completes rebrand to Trinity Airways (TravelExtra)
sources.note: Rebrand effective 2026-09-10; first aircraft in Trinity livery 737-8 HL8754; IATA TW / ICAO TWB kept.

sources.title: Trinity takes delivery of first Boeing 737-8 in new livery (AviTrader, 2026-09-09)
sources.note: 'distinctive Trinity gray and rose-gold livery'; aircraft delivered from ACG's orderbook.

sources.title: Trinity Airways logo (Commons)
sources.note: Symbol of three tapered pieces (a bar over two inward-slanting blades) in rose-gold/champagne gradients (#C1B494, #C69186, #C6C8C8), wordmark 'TRINITY' in warm gray #686058.

notes: Kind 'standard' because it is the airline's new fleet-wide scheme, but it is on very few aircraft (HL8754 first, Sept 2026; further ACG 737-8 deliveries through end-2026) and the rest of the fleet will be repainted over time. Draw once a dated, openly licensed photo exists; until then renderers should use the t'way scheme (standard).
history: Introduced with the rename of T'way Air to Trinity Airways, 2026-09-10.
